public_rationale: The records provide substantial evidence of losses at OpenAI and Anthropic. They do not establish the specified comparison for all three named businesses on a matching basis. The Perplexity reports could not be read, OpenAI's quoted loss is not identified as operating income, and Anthropic's filing uses GAAP. These limitations prevent a supported verdict under the required metric rules. The broader investment judgment also does not follow from one year's losses alone.
limitations: The measurable operating-cost reading is an interpretation of imprecise wording.
Inference costs, research spending, operating loss, net loss and cash burn are distinct.
The conclusion does not assess eventual profitability or investment returns.

our_interpretation: The nearest referents for 'these companies' are OpenAI, Anthropic and Perplexity. A claim about every generative AI business would be broader.
The ordinary measurable core is that realized revenue does not cover company-wide operating expenses, including research and development.
Use calendar 2024, the annual period described by the surrounding financial examples and the latest completed annual reporting period before the post.
The financial basis is estimate because the context relies on reported private-company financial figures.
Current operating losses do not by themselves establish that an investment is irrational or that a business can never become sustainable.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable 2024 figures show realized revenue below operating expenses for each of OpenAI, Anthropic and Perplexity.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable 2024 figures show that one or more of the named companies covered its operating expenses, defeating the assertion for that company.
